body:
Perhaps change...

 "Verify that the application is not susceptible to common XML attacks, such as XPath query tampering, XML External Entity attacks, and XML injection attacks."

... to ...

"Verify that the application is not susceptible XPath or XML based injection attacks." 

The goal is to move XXE to a separate item and make 5.14 more specific to xml injection.
title: Change 5.14 to only describe XML injections
